newsitem.title: USA: Rattlesnake no longer meets Nasdaq criteria.
newsitem.headline: Rattlesnake no longer meets Nasdaq criteria.

text.p: Rattlesnake Holding Co Inc said Wednesday that it had received a letter from the Nasdaq Stock Market indicating that the company is no longer in compliance with the requirements for continuing the quotation of its securities on the Nasdaq Stock Market.
The company said it is preparing a response to Nasdaq and formulating a plan to achieve compliance with the maintenance standards.
However, there can be no assurance that continued Nasdaq quotation will be obtained, it said.
